btc_monday.label: Bitcoin Monday Asia open (tracking)
btc_monday.note: Round 11 L4 (Concretum 2025): long Bitcoin from Sunday 19:00 New York for 24 hours. +0.075R over 481 weeks (1R = 25-day average daily range), p 0.019 in the research. Candidate: journalled, never alerted.

btc_skipped.note: Round 32 S2: Bitcoin trend setups the live rules skip because a trade is already open, each run on its own. +0.116R over 213 trades, positive in every period, p 0.064. Candidate: journalled, never alerted.

btc_trend.note: Round 10: the gold trend rules on Bitcoin, never tuned on it. Passed 1 of 63 market x strategy tests (p=0.0008 with weekday signals). Shadow: alerted as paper with no size until live trades back it up.

eth_inside_day.note: Round 16: the gold inside-day breakout on Ether, never tuned on it. gold_fixes.label: Gold between the London fixes (tracking)
gold_fixes.note: Round 11 L5 (Bell, SSRN 6077836): long gold from the 15:00 London candle to the close of the 10:00 candle next morning. +0.026R a day over 4,855 days (1R = 25-day average daily range), p 0.007 in the research. Thin per trade. Candidate: journalled, never alerted.

gold_m15.label: Gold 15-minute trigger (tracking)
gold_m15.note: Round 33 F2: gold's trend rules with the trigger on 15-minute candles, taken only when the 1-hour Heikin Ashi agrees. +0.074R over 1,631 trades 2008-26 (1.7/week, p 0.0032) but negative in 2023-24, so it missed the pass mark. Candidate: journalled, never alerted.

us_gap_fill.note: Round 13 N7 (Reddit catalogue #12): buy a gap down below a recent breakout on SPY, QQQ and DIA, out when the gap fills or at 5 ATR below entry. +0.305R over 263 trades (1R = 25-day average range), 94% winners, p 0.041 in the research. Candidate: journalled, never alerted.

us_ibs.label: US index IBS reversion
us_ibs.note: Round 12 M8: IBS band reversion, long only, on SPY, QQQ, DIA and IWM. Passed on the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow (p=2.6e-07 pooled over six indices), held on the Russell 2000, failed on ten non-US indices in round 15. No stop: the worst index trade in 2020 lost 31%. Shadow since 19 Nov 2026: paper alerts, never sized.

us_ibs_200.label: US index rebounds, 200-day filter (tracking)
us_ibs_200.note: Round 20 A3: the US index rebound rule, only above the 200-day average. Worst run of losses 23R against 36R for the base rule, average +0.54R against +0.48R, a third fewer trades. Missed the pre-set worst-trade bar, so tracked silently to let live trades decide between the two.
